author: Forbes
description:
Iran reopened the Strait of Hormuz to all commercial shipping traffic Friday, citing Thursday’s ceasefire with Israel in Lebanon, signaling a major breakthrough in the conflict and sending oil prices plummeting, though President Donald Trump said the U.S. Naval blockade on Iran will remain in effect until a permanent peace deal is reached.

author: Forbes
description: Nick and Bob have built brands like Dorn Rose, a sleep and wellness company, and Hears, a premium earplug brand for music and live events, scaling both across D2C, retail and B2B. What looks like momentum now is really years of testing products, refining positioning and figuring out what actually works behind the scenes. Anyone can start a brand. Few know how to scale one.
title: How Nick & Bob Scaled DTC Brands Across Retail And B2B

author: Forbes
description: Miha Jagodic started Bloq.it, a smart locker company for package delivery and storage, from a simple problem on a beach. He needed somewhere to store his things. Fast-forward a few years, and those lockers are now used more than 100 million times a year across 10 markets in Europe.
title: How Bloq.it Built A 100M-Use Locker Network

author: Forbes
description:
Are you overwhelmed by the sheer number of TV options in 2026? Between OLED, Mini LED and an influx of new AI features, choosing the right display for your home has never been more complicated.

In this video, Rebecca Isaacs, Forbes Vetted’s consumer tech & electronics editor, breaks down the top 5 best TVs of 2026. As an ISF-certified calibrator and display expert who has tested nearly every major model to hit the market, Rebecca shares the results of rigorous, hands-on testing to help you find a screen to fit your needs.

Whether you’re looking for a cinema-quality experience, a high-performance monitor for gaming or a budget-friendly model for your living room, this guide covers the best in class for every space and budget.
